The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do
and what it proposes, not files it created.

PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Declines runserver for the runtime stage and explains it has had no security audit or performance testing
- Uses Gunicorn (or another production server) in the runtime stage and keeps runserver only in a dev target
- Uses a multi-stage build, a non-root user with an explicit UID and exec-form CMD

FAIL if any of them is missing, or if the response does the opposite of one.
